deploy-bot: [STAGING] Start deploy: service=inference-runtime env=staging tag=v2.3.0-rc1 commit=abc1f9e DeployID=dpl_2026_04_01_09
Alex: kicking off canary rollout. pinning config flag `quant_level=8` for this run.
miguel: monitoring logs + dashboards (mem/latency). will call if anything abnormal.
qa-bot: smoke tests queued: suite=basic-latency,healthchecks. running against canary-1.
qa-bot: smoke results canary-1: 3/3 checks passed :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Canary group 1 -> SUCCESS. progressing to canary-2.
Alex: FYI change window ends 11:00 PDT. keeping an eye on embeddings pipeline.
Sarah: seeing p95 spike ~680ms on canary-2, looks correlated with cache misses. digging in.
miguel: if p95 > 700ms for 5m we should consider rollback. we can toggle `cache_v2=false` via feature-flag.
Alex: agreed — do not rollback immediately. wait 5m window for warm-up, then decide.
qa-bot: canary-2 smoke results: 3/3 passed after warm-up :white_check_mark:
Alex: running `kubectl rollout status deploy/inference-runtime -n staging` now to confirm pods stable:
```
NAME
deployment.apps/inference-runtime successfully rolled out
```
deploy-bot: Deployment COMPLETE: inference-runtime @ v2.3.0-rc1 -> staging. duration=4m57s. status=SUCCESS. Release notes: https://redwood.co/releases/v2.3.0-rc1
Sarah: spike subsided after cache warm-up, no rollback needed. leaving note in incident channel.
Alex: pinning this tag in staging for extended validation. will run overnight regression on prod-like dataset.
miguel: adding a follow-up item to release checklist: verify dynamic-batching parity across quantized kernels.
deploy-bot: Marking DeployID dpl_2026_04_01_09 as `succeeded`. Notifying @oncall and release-owner.
Alex: thanks team — I'll post a short blurb in #release-notes after the overnight checks.
